newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end down on NCD maturation.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end down on NCD maturation.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended lower on Tuesday on loose liquidity as the maturation of T$8 billion negotiable certifictes of deposit flushed the banking system with cash, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was at 5.308 percent against Monday's 5.348 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.30 percent against 5.45-5.50.
Dealers noted loosening liquidity as T$16 billion worth of NCDs was maturing this week, including T$8 billion on Tuesday alone.
The benchmark 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 5.8900-8950 percent, back from an early low of 5.82 percent, against Monday's 5.8950-8975 close.
